errors.text_span: Each model category includes a grouped set of three bars representing different SFT training conditions: “no SFT”, “+ SFT on D₀”, “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”.
errors.evidence: The figure shows four bars per model category, not three.

errors.text_span: The “no SFT” bars are colored blue, reaching approximately 65%, 67%, and 71% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: The blue bars are closer to about 66%, 70%, and 81%.

errors.text_span: The “+ SFT on D₀” bars are colored orange, reaching approximately 67%, 75% and 75% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: The orange bars are closer to about 66%, 73%, and 81%.

errors.text_span: The “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bars are colored lavender, reaching approximately 74%, 78% and 79% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively
errors.evidence: The lavender bars are closer to about 80%, 84%, and 84%.

errors.text_span: the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bars are colored pink and reach approximately 76%, 80% and 80% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: The pink bars are closer to about 83%, 80%, and 83%.

errors.text_span: The “+ SFT on D₀” bars are colored orange
errors.evidence: The + SFT on D₀ bars are shown in light yellow/orange with horizontal white stripes, but the description omits the distinctive stripe pattern and slightly mischaracterizes the exact hue.

errors.text_span: The “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bars are colored lavender
errors.evidence: The + SFT on D₀, D₁ bars are lavender with slanted white stripes, but the description omits the stripe pattern.

errors.text_span: the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bars are colored pink
errors.evidence: The + SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂ bars are peach/salmon colored solid fills rather than distinctly pink.
The description does not mention the distinct bar fill patterns/striping used to differentiate conditions.
